notes.title: CODEDOOR V3.1 – Patch Notes
notes.content:
CODEDOOR V3.1 – Patch Notes

Increased speed of player, zombies, and other entities.

Increased frequency of rare gameplay events.

Improved collision between player and zombies.

Quality improvements to maps.

Added "Switch Weapons" controls to the instructions menu (Keyboard/Mouse and Controller).

Audio fixes.

General bug fixes.

Enjoy the update!

notes.title: 🌟 CODEDOOR V2.1.1 Now Live! 🌟
notes.content:
Hello CODEDOOR Community,

We're excited to roll out another update to enhance your CODEDOOR experience. Here’s what’s new in V2.1.1:

🚀 Improvements

Visual Consistency: We've adjusted the game visuals to ensure they look excellent on any quality setting. Regardless of the machine you're playing on, the game will now display consistent and appealing visuals.

Pick-Up Visibility: We've resolved an issue where essential items were not appearing for players on lower-end systems. Thanks to insights from the community, everyone can now see and collect all necessary game items, ensuring a complete gaming experience.

🎯 Special Thanks

A huge shout-out to TAE Games and shep7000. Watching TAE Games struggle with visibility on lower settings in their YouTube video opened our eyes to needed changes. Likewise, shep7000's direct feedback about invisible pickups was invaluable in pinpointing and fixing this issue. Thanks to both of you for helping make CODEDOOR better for everyone.

Thank you to the entire community for your ongoing support and engagement. Dive into the updated version and keep the feedback coming!

Best regards,
Yazeed

notes.title: CODEDOOR V2.1
notes.content:
Hello everyone,

I've made some changes to CODEDOOR based on community feedback and have updated a few things:

 After reaching 30 kills and advancing to wave 10 or further, the game will shift to a nighttime setting for the endgame, accompanied by a distinct sound cue, where you can then find the nuke and launch it to claim victory.
 Bullets and magazines will now only spawn when you pick up the gun, preventing the player from collecting ammo without a gun.
 Adjusted the font styles for uniformity across the game (most fonts should now match).
 Minor bug fixes


Thank you for your continued support and gameplay!

Sincerely,
Yazeed.

notes.title: CODEDOOR V2
notes.content:
🌟 CODEDOOR V2 Now Live! 🌟


Hello CODEDOOR Community,

We are excited to share that CODEDOOR V2 is now available! This major update introduces new gameplay elements, refined features, and a definitive way to triumph. Here’s what’s new in the latest release:

🚀 New Features
M1911 Pistol: Find and use the M1911 with systems for bullet replenishment and random magazine pickups.

Refined Movement: Our movement system has been streamlined for smoother navigation through the game's challenges.

Enhanced Graphics: Enjoy updated visuals with new materials and improved models for containers and zombies.

Empowered Defense: Now you can fight back with the newly added capability to shoot zombies.

🔥 Major Feature
Nuke Launch Mechanic: The ultimate win condition—reach Wave 10 and accumulate 30 kills to unlock and launch the nuke. Successfully launching the nuke is the only way to win the game, culminating in a true apocalyptic sight.

🎯 Achievement
Launch The Nuke: Complete the game by meeting the nuke launch conditions.

Thank you to our wonderful community for your ongoing support. We're eager to see how you all take on these new challenges and make your mark in CODEDOOR V2.

Dive into the new version now and experience the suspense and thrill first-hand!

Best regards,
Yazeed

notes.title: 🌟 CODEDOOR - Update 1.1 Now Live! 🌟
notes.content:
New Features

 Instruction Menu: Dive into the game with ease! We've added a new instruction menu that not only guides you through the controls but also gives you a glimpse into the exciting world of CODEDOOR.


Game Enhancements

 Advanced Locomotion System: Elevate your gameplay with the introduction of a metahuman with Advanced Locomotion System (ALS). Experience more realistic and fluid character movements as you navigate through the levels.
 Level Enhancements: We've given all levels a boost! Expect more refined and engaging gameplay in each stage.


Bug Fixes & Improvements

 Timer Fix: Say goodbye to endless loops. We've fixed the timer issue, so now the game will properly end when it's supposed to.
 Pause Functionality: Need a break? You can now pause the game, giving you control over your playtime.
 Game Flow Correction: We've squashed a pesky bug that incorrectly looped the last level back to the previous one. Now, finishing a level progresses the game as intended.
 Sound Improvements: We've fine-tuned the game's sound for a more immersive and enjoyable audio experience.


Happy gaming, and we can't wait for you to dive into CODEDOOR Version 1.1!
